description: PostgreSQL 18 pseudo-type catalogs, stable OIDs, record array metadata, regtype lookup, and supported routine signatures
sql: CREATE FUNCTION type_matrix_pseudo_identity(value anyelement) RETURNS anyelement LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN value; END';
CREATE FUNCTION type_matrix_pseudo_compatible(value anycompatiblearray) RETURNS anycompatiblearray LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN value; END';
CREATE FUNCTION type_matrix_pseudo_record() RETURNS record LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN NULL; END';
CREATE FUNCTION type_matrix_pseudo_event() RETURNS event_trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN RETURN; END';
SELECT oid, typname, typtype, typcategory, typlen, typbyval, typalign, typstorage, typarray FROM pg_type WHERE typtype = 'p' ORDER BY oid;
SELECT proname, pg_get_function_arguments(oid), pg_get_function_result(oid) FROM pg_proc WHERE proname LIKE 'type_matrix_pseudo_%' ORDER BY proname;
